author: aterigun
body:
computeResolution() in DQMGenericClient produces _Mean and _Sigma histograms. The relative resolution (sigma/mean) is currently computed downstream in plotting scripts, e.g. Validation/RecoJets/scripts/makeJetValidationPlots.py.

This adds an optional _Resolution histogram computed by the harvester itself, with the error propagated as sqrt((ds/m)^2 + (s*dm/m^2)^2).

It is opt-in and off by default, so existing clients are unaffected:
- vstring: a fifth token "relative" in the resolution / resolutionProfile command
- VPSet: relative = cms.untracked.bool(True) in resolutionSets / resolutionProfileSets

The new histogram follows the same binning as _Mean and _Sigma, including the variable-bin case.
title: DQMGenericClient: optionally compute relative resolution (sigma/mean)
